parameters.content:
PHASE 1: INGESTION & SECURITY

Receives incoming webhook payload   >  Filters out bots/honeypots   >  Sanitizes, Filter spam Domains & normalizes lead data into clean E.164 formats.

PHASE 2: AI INTEL & CRM SYNC

Syncs with HubSpot CRM  >  Deterministic scoring matrix  >  Gemini AI analyzes intent, urgency, and generates lead summaries.

PHASE 3: AUDIT LOGGING & PERSISTENCE

Captures completed lead interactions from both HOT and WARM paths into Airtable for permanent record-keeping and audit tracking.

PHASE 4: HIGH-PRIORITY OUTREACH (HOT)

Routes high-intent leads (Score ≥ 70) to instant Slack VIP channels, sales phone tasks, automated WhatsApp outreach, and syncs enriched status to HubSpot.

PHASE 5: LOW-PRIORITY NURTURING ENGINE (WARM / COLD)

Routes lower-scoring leads (< 70)    >  Sends automated email auto-replies, queues secondary sales calls, and updates contact records in HubSpot.

PHASE 6: FAIL-SAFE, BOT ISOLATION, SLACK ALERT & SECURITY AUDIT

Isolates malicious bot entries, honeypot triggers, missing contact details, and disposable email domains into dedicated security logs without clogging primary CRM pipelines & nOtify team through Slack.

🚀 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ENTERPRISE ROI


🎯 WHAT THIS ENGINE DOES:
An enterprise inbound pipeline automating real-time lead ingestion, bot filtering, dynamic AI scoring, dual-track sales routing, HubSpot CRM sync, and native engine-level error monitoring.

💰 PRACTICAL ROI & VALUE:
• ⚡ Sub-5-Second Speed-to-Lead: Instant WhatsApp & Slack VIP alerts capture high-intent buyers before competitors reply.

• 🛡️ CRM Data Integrity: Blocks bots, honeypots, spam domains, and disposable emails before touching HubSpot records.

• 🧠 Automated Qualification: Replaces manual lead triage with hybrid business rules + Gemini AI intent analysis.

• 🚨 Centralized Engine Resilience: Configured via native Workflow Settings to trigger instant Slack + Gmail alerts with a 1-click execution link for immediate incident resolution.

This Workflow automatically filters out spam and bot form fills, uses AI to instantly score real buyers, and alerts your sales team via Slack and WhatsApp in under 5 seconds so you close high-intent leads before your competitors even respond.

parameters.query:
WITH upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO inbound_cleanse_dlq (
        first_name,
        last_name,
        email,
        phone,
        company,
        budget,
        notes,
        raw_payload,
        error_message,
        status,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    ) 
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8::jsonb,
        $9,
        'PENDING',
        NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila',
        NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE SET
        first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
        last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
        phone = EXCLUDED.phone,
        company = EXCLUDED.company,
        budget = EXCLUDED.budget,
        notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
        raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
        error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
        status = 'PENDING',
        updated_at = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila'
    WHERE 
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.first_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.first_name OR
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.last_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.last_name OR
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.phone IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.phone OR
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.company IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.company OR
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.budget IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.budget OR
        inbound_cleanse_dlq.notes IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.notes
    RETURNING 
        id, 
        first_name,
        last_name,
        email,
        phone,
        company,
        budget,
        notes,
        status, 
        created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila' AS created_at_pst,
        updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila' AS updated_at_pst
)
SELECT * FROM upsert;
